readings.strict: a provenance-map entry, or the name inside a backtick span of SKILL.md or references/*.md
readings.loose: a provenance-map entry, or the name as a whole word anywhere in SKILL.md or references/*.md (also matches English words such as color or config)

counts.skf_measured_tier_a_set: Skill Forge's own inventory credited 204 of the 280 (72.86%) in re-test 20261103T073923Z-970f8905, before the last repairs; the final run names no tier A export

skf_inventory_combined.formula: 204 (Skill Forge's own inventory count for the 280, re-test 20261103T073923Z-970f8905) + 45 (missing names the strict reading finds documented)
skf_inventory_combined.caveat: mixes a count taken before the last repairs (204) with one taken after them
